title: The actual finite scalar map and the heart realization
statement:
For every scheme X and finite discrete commutative topological ring A, the specified finiteScalarMap of [def-sfb-embedded-finite-coefficient-realization] is invertible. Extension along it is an equivalence. Define finiteHeartRealization to be that actual scalar extension followed by integralModelIntrinsicRealization of [def-sfb-integral-model-generator-data]. This is a literal construction with no choice of an unproved existence witness.

Exact Lean assertion:
theorem finiteScalarMap_isIso (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type) [CommRing A]
    [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [Finite A] [DiscreteTopology A] :
    IsIso (finiteScalarMap.{u} X A)

source.place: First paragraph, clauses (1) and (2); Stacks Tags 099L, 03ET, 00YV, 06YQ and 09AL.

proof.text: Use the canonical constant-function presheaf map. A section has a finite clopen covering by its fibres; it lifts to the corresponding constant on each fibre. If unequal constants have equal images, the profinite set is empty, so its empty cover gives local injectivity. Sheafification of the locally bijective map and the sheafification counit are isomorphisms. The constant/forgetful comparison identifies their composite with exactly constantToContinuous, hence with finiteScalarPointMap after forgetting to abelian groups. Pullback gives the stated isomorphism.

Use Mod.comapEquivalenceOfIsIso and Mod.extendScalarsIsoComapInv to identify scalar extension along finiteScalarMap with the inverse restriction equivalence. Define finiteHeartRealization by composition with the existing intrinsic heart realization.
